# The downstream evaluation environment, pinned and hashed (linux x86_64, CI).
#
# One environment for the cross-method downstream tasks (docs/DOWNSTREAM.md):
# ADE20K segmentation, COCO detection, NYUv2 depth and SSv2 video. It is the fleet
# timm closure (torch/torchvision/timm at the fleet versions) plus the task
# dependencies that no method carries: pycocotools (COCO mAP), h5py (NYUv2 .mat)
# and av / PyAV (SSv2 video decode). Unlike a method lock this is CI-only and
# single-platform (the downstream job runs on ubuntu-latest); install with hashes:
#
#   pip install --require-hashes \
#       --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu \
#       --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
#       -r downstream/requirements.lock.txt
#
# Generated by `uv pip compile` (cpu index, cp312, x86_64, --generate-hashes),
# held to the fleet's shared pins. Regenerate the same way after a dep change.
